the probe records identity_receipt_sha256 but does not compare it to an externally expected canonical receipt digest
the probe requires candidate_id equality and identity_complete=true, then treats file_manifest rows as the expected file hashes

file_manifest_sha256 is copied into checkpoint_bundle_identity but is not recomputed and checked by this probe

the receipt records logits shape and the last-position top1 token id
the probe does not record a cryptographic digest of the complete output tensor or a generated-output byte/token digest

Its standalone PASS is not self-authenticating canonical checkpoint provenance unless a higher-level repository-bound runner pins the exact identity-receipt digest, and its forward evidence is occurrence/top1 evidence rather than full output-identity evidence.

relation_to_v48.v48_narrowing_required: The phrase selection-grade consumed identity should remain conditional on an externally pinned identity root plus the separately identified loaded-model-state consumption gap. hypothesis_fusion.hypothesis: A minimal repository-bound execution wrapper can preserve V1 and close the identity-root gap by pinning candidate_id + exact identity-receipt SHA-256 + probe source blob/commit + frozen local snapshot identity before execution. A separate v2 model-call receipt should add loaded-state reconciliation and output digest only where downstream checkpoint selection, J-Space causality or NODE_RESULT lineage needs complete call identity.
hypothesis_fusion.counterhypothesis: If the existing future execution request already pins the exact committed identity-receipt file hash and a separate matched evaluator independently binds model outputs, modifying V1 itself would duplicate authority and unnecessarily couple checkpoint eligibility to downstream evaluation semantics.
hypothesis_fusion.decision_rule: Do not redesign V1 until the exact repository-bound runner is inspected. Require the runner to carry the root-of-trust; only add an expected-receipt argument to V1 if no higher-level exact pin exists. Require full output digest only for scopes that claim exact model-call/output lineage, not merely that a forward occurred.

recommended_contract_split.CHECKPOINT_INPUT_IDENTITY_ABI_v1: eligibility/input evidence: exact externally pinned identity receipt + manifest/opened-shard evidence + renderer/token tensor identity + observed forward occurrence
recommended_contract_split.CHECKPOINT_MODEL_STATE_CONSUMPTION_ABI_v: loaded-state evidence: deterministic in-memory parameter/buffer state digest independently reconciled to admitted checkpoint identity
recommended_contract_split.MODEL_CALL_LINEAGE_ABI_v1: causal call evidence: exact runtime + externally authenticated checkpoint identity + consumed model-state digest + rendered/token input digest + complete declared output digest + call id
recommended_contract_split.downstream_rule: NODE_RESULT/J-Space/matched-evaluation receipts may reference MODEL_CALL_LINEAGE_ABI but model output never mints membership, freshness, DB, EffectGate or provider authority.
